title: Round, do not truncate
prompt: Return the value as the nearest whole number, so 7.9 becomes 8 and 7.2 becomes 7. Remember int() alone drops decimals.
hints: round() first, then int() to get a whole-number type.

docs.name: int(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as a whole number; decimals are dropped, text like "42" is read.

docs.name: round(x)
docs.what: Returns the nearest whole number as a float.
